what: The borrow check step is never stored: hir-ty-borrowck lib.rs check_def reads Body::unmoved_source_map (so Body::relative or with_source_map) before mir_body, for the lowering diagnostics. blaze-item-hash refuses that read (positions; docs/v2/plan/lanes/item-hash/reads.md, Refused, Body::relative), and body_store offered() stops at the first refusal, so no borrow check verdict is offered and its MIR read is never a StepMir fact. blaze-item-hash classify::own_earlier_steps_are_step_facts fails on this in every round since 3d. Please have the borrow check read a position-free tracked query of the body (whether lowering had a diagnostic other than InactiveCode, keyed by DefWithBodyId, in hir-def). I (item-hash side, tests-misc-front1) will then cover it as OwnBody once the identity hashes what it depends on, as reads.md says lifts it.
